supported_findings: Linear publicly documents a GraphQL API for querying and mutating data.
Linear documents OAuth 2.0 and personal API keys as ways to authenticate requests to its API.
Linear’s own documentation identifies GitHub-linked issue automation as a product feature.
In its May 23, 2024 account of multi-region support, Linear describes replicated regional production deployments, each operating against a single database instance, rather than a sharded database.
Linear’s May 23, 2024 engineering post identifies Cloudflare Workers as the request-routing proxy for its multi-region deployment, with a stated authentication and regional-forwarding role.
Linear’s developer documentation identifies a public GraphQL API for queries and mutations and documents OAuth 2.0 and personal API keys for API authentication.
